<thought>We need the SMILES of the unknown sample. The only way to infer it is to obtain its mass spectrum to get the molecular weight, then retrieve possible molecular formulas, generate isomers, and match their simulated spectra to the observed spectra. This multi-step approach is necessary because no tool directly returns the SMILES. We'll start by getting the mass spectrum.</thought>
